# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old (as of volume 3)  <sub>[v3 c22 P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c6 P36](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0036), [v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Abernethy  <sub>[v1 c6 P5](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0005), [v1 c8 P8](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0008), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunt Thirza  <sub>[v1 c8 P8](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0008), [v1 c8 P12](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

She has a tall, slender, angular frame with dark hair streaks of gray bound at the back in a tight bun held by wire hairpins. Her hands are rough and labor-calloused, and her face is lined and wrinkled in her later years.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c34 P6](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0006), [v1 c38 P19](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0019), [v2 c12 P39](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0039)_

## Personality

Thirza is a rigid, reserved, and deeply practical woman possessed of a strong sense of morality and strict decorum. Though she rarely demonstrates affection through outward words or physical affection, she feels deep, intense love for those in her care. Over time, she softens into a warmer, milder demeanor.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016)_

- Strict sense of morality  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- Reserved and restrained  <sub>[v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farming and house management  <sub>[v1 c6 P36](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0036), [v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008)</sub>

## Goals

- Raise and properly educate Nell Harcourt and the orphans under her roof  <sub>[v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001)</sub>
- Maintain the family homestead, Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023)</sub>

## History

Thirza Abernethy lived a quiet life at Grey Shutters alongside her brother Obed. Her routine shifted dramatically when an orphan girl, Nell Harcourt, arrived by mistake instead of the boy they had requested. Though initially intent on returning Nell, Thirza softened and decided to keep and rear the girl. Over the years, she formed a profound maternal bond with Nell, taking pride in her academic achievements and character. Following Obed's death, Thirza faced financial and emotional strain, nearly selling Grey Shutters, but Nell chose to stay and teach in Brierley to preserve the home. Later, Thirza agreed to adopt two orphaned twins, Robin and Lucy Farrow. She also invited the widowed Mrs. Agatha Sowerby to move into Grey Shutters to live with her. In later years, Thirza traveled to Seven Gulls to spend Christmas with Nell and assist her during childbearing.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c23 P24](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0024), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010), [v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c26 P28](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0028), [v4 c15 P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c19 P4](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0004)_

- Raised in Grey Shutters on the outskirts of Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
